final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_kept AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS first_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS benchmark FROM first_kept), final_orders AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.first_excess, f.avg_fill - b.benchmark AS second_excess FROM first_kept f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark b WHERE f.avg_fill > b.benchmark) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_final_fill_quantity, AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM final_orders.
